title: Public closed-loop wrist-servo logs, metrics and tuning campaigns for Nussbaum-function PID
authors: Danial Zafaranchizadeh Moghaddam; Olga Tveretina; Abolfazl Zaraki
finding: 17 time-series paths, 16 unique blobs and 97,920 retained rows. The final 7,200 samples recover the pre-clamp request and verify the clipped internal command to 1.12e-10 internal units. Five headline search files and six supplementary trial-summary files were read. Measured current is an onboard register, not a torque transducer.
rights: Root LICENSE grants MIT for software/documentation and reserves manuscript/figures for scholarly reading. No separate raw-data redistribution grant identified. Original aggregate statistics and source pointers only.

title: Data underlying the publication: A Novel Tribometer and a Comprehensive Testing Method for Rolling-Sliding Conditions
authors: Pedro Amoroso; Aleks Vrček; Matthijn de Rooij
version: 4TU version 1; .7z published file, verified MD5 and SHA-256
finding: 139 measurement text files with six concurrent channels, 3,057,305 rows. File names give nominal braking setpoints; no logged unclamped controller effort, coil current or limiting flag.
rights: Data CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. This package gives a citation, an original checking script, and three group-level descriptions; source measurements, scripts and figures stay at 4TU.

title: Permanent Magnet Direct Current Worm Geared Motor Data: Voltage, Current, and Speed
authors: Wallace Pereira Neves dos Reis; Giselle Elias Couto; Orides Morandin Junior
finding: 22 numeric sheets, two motors; 199,681 complete rows and 24 incomplete numeric rows. PWM, measured voltage, current, encoder, speed and direction; 213 strictly increasing time segments (reset is an operational boundary, not proof of an independent trial).
rights: Mendeley Data CC BY 4.0; computed summaries and original replay script.

title: CREATOR Case: Induction Motor Data
authors: Kourosh Heidarikani; Pawan Kumar Dhakal; Annette Muetze; Roland Seebacher
finding: Drive-cycle ZIP read with member CRC verification. Six joined speed/torque reference and electrical/mechanical power groups, 18,438 equally indexed time points across groups. The two raw shaft channels required to distinguish torque and speed error are not in those 24 CSV files.
rights: Data CC BY-NC 4.0; authors credited; independently recomputed noncommercial analytical summaries only.

title: Aquired Dataset for Adaptive Uncertainty Regulation in Interval Type-2 Fuzzy Servo Controller.
finding: 1,000 class-grouped eight-feature rows. All 167 saturation-labelled rows are in a single block. u_max ranges 53.8–166.3, also covering 396 rows with other labels. No time column or independently measured load.
rights: CC BY 4.0; author credited and grouped statistics derived from original CSV.
